daily_full_grid.dedup_rule: draft grid_params(): sell_rule=fixed resets trail_ignite/trail_cap/upper_tp/l2_solo to base; sell_rule=code resets fixed_tp to base; identical Params collapse to one
daily_full_grid.method: daily bars synthesized from Kiwoom minute bars (step3 daily_from_minute)

full_period_daily.note: minute-less periods judged on daily bars only, stated explicitly. run() varies protect_ratio x tower_order only (4 tracks, all remain=hold); baseline track is hold/protect 0/id_desc.
full_period_daily.source: yahoo daily + naver repair (engine hbt_data.load cache; pre-fetched with 35s gaps, no 429)

minute_staged_grid.core_8: remain {sniper, hold} x protect_ratio {0, 0.2} x tower_order {id_desc, avg_desc}, all else baseline
minute_staged_grid.method: Kiwoom minute bars + same 18 settings on minute-synthesized daily bars
minute_staged_grid.why_staged: full minute grid (1008 settings x 4 tickers x ~8.5s per minute simulate) is ~9.5 core-hours, ~6+ wall-hours on this 1.5-shared-CPU VM; not feasible in-session. Staged per task fallback: (1) 8-bundle core, (2) one-factor-at-a-time.

ranking.row: liq_ (full-period liquidation-deducted). The draft's sweep falls back to liq_ because config_step3.json segment types are 상승/박스/하락, so the 하락·박스 combined (main_) set is empty.
ranking.rules: depletion >= 1 -> excluded; positive CAGR by Calmar; non-positive CAGR after positives by CAGR then MDD; Calmar None -> judgment-deferred regardless of sign
ranking.scope_daily_full: within each of 8 tracks (remain x protect x tower_order)
ranking.scope_minute: per ticker across the 18 staged settings
